mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Users (user_id, password, username, phone, email, region, grade) VALUES (#{userId}, #{password}, #{username}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{region}, #{grade})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, password, username, phone, email, region, profile_image, grade, created_signup_time FROM Users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM Users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM Users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE Users SET profile_image = #{profileImage} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE Users SET password = #{password} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
